info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Model By Param1-spec
info.description: The Financial Instrument Valuation Model Update API allows for the modification of existing financial instrument valuation models using specific parameters. This endpoint is designed to cater to financial institutions and investment firms seeking to maintain accurate and relevant valuation models. By utilizing a PATCH request, consumers can efficiently update aspects of these models without the need to replace them entirely. Typical use cases include adjusting parameters in response to market conditions or regulatory requirements. This API is crucial for ensuring that financial assessments remain current and reliable.

patch.summary: Update a financial instrument valuation model.
patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of an existing financial instrument valuation model identified by the provided resource ID. Ensure that you include the necessary fields in the request body to reflect the changes you wish to perform.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the financial instrument valuation model identified by RES-100045. The payload should include the necessary fields that are to be modified in the existing model. Ensure that all required properties conform to the defined schema.
